authority.governance: existing require_governance wrappers: MODERATE store/context, HIGH delete
authority.scope: tenant_id = resolve_tenant_id(current_user); user_id = current_user.id; agent_id = optional explicit query parameter
authority.tenant_less_fallback: resolve_tenant_id falls back to the personal tenant id 'default'
authority.role_requirement: none added beyond the existing authenticated/governance contract

routes.effect: durable scoped TenantSetting create or conditional update, plus one AuditLog receipt
routes.transitions: insert when absent; update only when the exact prior setting_value still matches; stale/competing write -> 409 effect=none

routes.effect: durable scoped context merge, plus one AuditLog receipt
routes.transitions: merge preserves unseen fields; competing merge -> 409 effect=none; same-operation replay -> already_applied

routes.effect: durable scoped conditional delete, plus one AuditLog tombstone receipt
routes.transitions: missing -> 404; stale delete -> 409; same-operation tombstone replay -> already_applied

read_consumers.scope: caller's exact scope; cannot read another user/tenant/agent
scans only the caller's scoped key prefix
caller's exact scope; missing returns empty context as before

storage.document: schema, exact scope, key/session, value/context, metadata, revision, timestamp
storage.migration: none; existing TenantSetting rows are namespaced and other consumers filter specific keys

durable_ledger.operation_identity: AuditLog.id is the server-owned operation id memory:<store|context|delete>:<supplied-or-generated>
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no raw value, metadata, key, session content, secret, SQL parameter or exception text is stored or returned in logs
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session on the same engine; audit fields and the stored setting digest must match the original operation

result_states.verified: success shape plus additive verification/operation_id/audit_id; effect=committed
result_states.already_applied: same operation id and request material; one receipt/effect; replay=do_not_repeat
result_states.conflict: HTTP 409 typed STALE_TARGET / OPERATION_CONFLICT / NOT_FOUND; effect=none
result_states.not_applied: HTTP 409 confirmed local rollback; effect=none; MEMORY_TRANSACTION_ROLLED_BACK; target/audit absent
result_states.effect_unknown: HTTP 503; effect=unknown; original identity; replay=do_not_repeat; no exception text

parallel_writers.memory_routes: sole writer of the memory: and memory-context: TenantSetting namespaces
parallel_writers.tenant_setting_consumers: billing, governance alerts, BYOK/credential and other readers filter by specific setting_key; the memory namespace does not match them
parallel_writers.audit_consumers: existing AuditLog surface; additive safe receipt

not_covered: the remaining memory surfaces and whole-app ORACLE-01
